name: Adonis
source:
A noble young man that lily meets in the castle town.
He has a languid demeanor, and he accompanies the protagonist on his travels, perhaps because he has too much free time on his hands.
His weapon of choice is a sword. He fights with two swords if given a dagger.
In this world where magic is rare, he is a young man who can use recovery magic for some reason.
